purpose: review-only; not executable authorization or initialized publisher state

before.snapshotStatus: historical identity snapshot; reverify all fields during execution

orderedGates: Review latest integrated cutover PR, independent review and exact-head applicable CI; normal merge main-off/production-only first. Existing healthy deployment continues; ordinary main merges may accumulate.

Prove main-off merge creates no provider request; close every known legacy/unknown request and fully paginate deployment inventory. Approve distinct M and L/D; legacy own CI/READY/public health and production-disabled source are required.
After separate execution authorization: establish/read back literal production protection without broadening actor or main permissions. Prepare dedicated mirror and existing credential paths.

check-stage and init require --expected-main M --expected-legacy-source L --legacy-deployment D. Project still tracks main; seed ref absent. Create single inactive immutable handover DB/witness BEFORE seed.

Seed rechecks pins/legacy/inventory, fsyncs intent and commits SQL, then atomic main M->M / production zero->L, force:false. M disables main and L disables production; verify no extra CI/Preview/provider request.
Unknown seed only reconciles read-only; ref L plus unchanged inventory confirms, absent ref stays unknown forever. No automatic retry or rejection classification by generic error text.
Record tracking-intent after init+3660 conservative unproven-setting floor. Save only original project Branch Tracking to production; do not Deploy. Unknown never repeats Save or unlocks by time.
Confirm tracking and unchanged legacy/inventory from durable intent. Once every legacy/bootstrap outcome settles, enable a NEW full 3660-second hold; latest M CI may still be pending.

Install sole fixed-source launchd. Tick selects only latest main with latest same-source successful CI; preserve locks/witness/no-force CAS/idempotence and block late legacy/foreign/duplicate deployments.
Accept two real useful-change windows using exact provider and public HTTP sources, without empty commits; only then Done.
notAuthorizedInThisPhase: create or update production ref or protection
seed, init, enable, recover-failure, scheduler installation or tick
merge cutover PR or change Vercel production branch/settings
new deployment, support contact, payment, account migration, new token/hook or CI write grant

rollback.first: disable offline and unload only the publisher's launchd entry; preserve journal, witness, lock and every uncertain receipt
rollback.wait: do not restore a deployment-producing chain before all in-flight outcomes settle and max(last legacy/publication/acceptance observations) + 3660 seconds has passed
rollback.project: restore original project tracking to main while source main deployment remains disabled; read back no deployment
rollback.source: normal reviewed PR restores only main deployment after replacement is stopped and cooldown is satisfied; no force-push or deletion of production
rollback.result: legacy chain restored means hourly control no longer active; keep GET-314 In Progress

pins.rule: Explicitly approve current exclusive-policy main M separately from last settled healthy legacy L/D. Never auto-adopt a new source. M need not equal live or have completed CI for nonpublishing bootstrap; actual publish always requires latest-main CI success.

f1.status: historical; no longer an executable seed pin

historicalLegacy.rule: Uncontrolled legacy intervals, not evidence of hourly enforcement; final PR338 fdc3/f1 plan and CI are historical.

unknownRule: Every seed/tracking intent survives restart and DB rollback checks. Unknown never times out, follows another main, clears history or resends. Definitive atomic rejection recovery is deliberately offline/reviewed, not guessed from exceptions.
trackingFloor: init+3660 retained only for unproven Branch Tracking settings side effects; not a global main freeze, not main==live, and not a seed delay. Removal requires exact no-request evidence and reviewed code.
